opening.argument: The speaker directs viewers to move Bitcoin into BitConnect, exchange it, and pledge the funds on the platform: "You have to transfer money into your bitcoin wallet. Then exchange this money with bitconnect." He links lending-wallet deposits to interest and promotes compounding examples in which $100 becomes $1,370 after six months and $21,000 after a year. The video also displays daily-profit and daily-interest figures, while directing viewers to platform-joining links: "below this video you will find links to join different platforms." Although the speaker acknowledges risk and recommends research, those qualifications do not change the central promotion of cryptocurrency lending platforms, unusually large returns, and an explicitly unverified affiliation claim.
